issue.title: Tests failing because of syslog error message related with brcm_sai_get_port_serdes_attribute_cmn

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

High

### Description of the bug

With SAI 14.3 upgrade, we observed the following errors when querying port serdes attributes with a null buffer (expecting SAI_STATUS_BUFFER_OVERFLOW): (this is the standard way of checking sai attribute support in prod code)

```
ERR syncd#syncd: [none] SAI_API_PORT:brcm_sai_get_port_serdes_attribute_cmn:18718 RX VGA get failed with error -8.
ERR syncd#syncd: [none] SAI_API_PORT:brcm_sai_get_port_serdes_attribute_cmn:18705 Port 68: TX_FIR_TAPS_LIST get failed with error -8

```
As error -8 corresponds to SAI_STATUS_BUFFER_OVERFLOW, it appears the log severity may need to be adjusted within the SAI implementation.
Now that counterpoll phy is enabled by default in master and 202511 branches we may see mgmt tests failing because of the above errors.
Until it is fixed in SAI we need to add this ignore for the port phy serdes attrs so that we may not fall into mgmt regressions.

### Steps to Reproduce

steps not required counterpoll phy is enabled by default.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

We must not see the -8 error sai logs

### Relevant log output

```shell
ERR syncd#syncd: [none] SAI_API_PORT:brcm_sai_get_port_serdes_attribute_cmn:18718 RX VGA get failed with error -8.
ERR syncd#syncd: [none] SAI_API_PORT:brcm_sai_get_port_serdes_attribute_cmn:18705 Port 68: TX_FIR_TAPS_LIST get failed with error -8
```
